answers.solution:
I diagnosed the issue against the actual installed `gitreins` 0.15.0 source and verified every claim with a live repro. The full write-up is at:

**`/home/kara/gitreins-untracked-lint-solution.md`**

## What I found

**Root cause (confirmed in source):** `engine/lang_detect.py` hard-codes the Python lint command as `ruff check . --quiet`, and `engine/pipeline.py::tier1_plan` runs it verbatim. The `.` makes Ruff recurse the whole workdir, so untracked non-ignored `.tmp_tick_*.py` files get linted and fail the lane with E401. `guards.lint_command` appears only in docstrings/local variables — it is never read, so config cannot narrow the scope.

**Verified fixes** (all reproduced with `gitreins guard --full` and `task complete --skip-tier2`):
- ✅ Add `.tmp_tick_*.py` to `.gitignore` — best fix: also removes the file from `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` used by `_tree_python_files` and `lang_detect`.
- ✅ Add `[tool.ruff] extend-exclude` — works because the pipeline runs `ruff check .` and the guard uses `--force-exclude`.
- ✅ Delete/rename the probes.
- ❌ **Staging them does not work** — `ruff check .` still scans the file (I proved this; the problem statement's "or stage them" remedy is wrong).

**Tier-2 timeout:** `_persist_result` runs only after `evaluate_task` returns, so a SIGKILL mid-Tier-2 leaves no `verdict.json`. The robust fix is the built-in detached runner — `gitreins task complete <id> --force --skip-tier2` then `gitreins judge <id> --async`, polled with `gitreins judge --status <job_id>`. I exercised this: the worker uses `start_new_session=True`, is disk-backed under `~/.local/share/gitreins/jobs/`, and returned `Status: complete` with `Tier 1: PASS` after the dispatching shell had exited.

I also noted a minor 0.15.0 bug: `_cmd_judge_async` calls `new_job_id()` twice, so the printed `log:` path can name a different id than the job id.

signatures.description: GitReins tier1 lint guard scans ALL python files in the workdir, not just staged ones, so untracked harness litter (.tmp_tick_*.py scratch probes) turns a valid commit red with E401 - the verdict FAILs a code change that is entirely clean (auger tick 2026-09-23: fb2bff77 FAIL on lint E401 in .tmp_tick_board.py while tier2 judged the code COMPLETE/PASS on every criterion). Config lint_command is documented as NOT read by the installed gitreins, so the file selection cannot be narrowed via config. Remedy: delete scratch *.py files before any gitreins task complete, or stage them if they must exist. Also: tier2 judge on the same task completed in 23min but a bare `gitreins task complete` run inside a 420s terminal window gets killed mid-Tier-2 with NO verdict.json; the working recovery is task complete --force --skip-tier2 (fast flip) then a synchronous judge run inside a background script file, which completed and PASSed.
